title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | Stock Market Outlook
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Ukraine/Russia, the Middle East/Iran and unrest in Europe make this the most unstable world since about 2003, favoring energy and materials.
Breadth broadening into defensives and energy points to S&P outperforming the Nasdaq.
Defense selling on expectations of a Democratic sweep and lower spending looks already priced in.
With no trend, treat today as either a quick scalp or slow long-term building with tight stops, not a swing chase.

calls.reason: Overnight bounce ran into the top of the October volume profile and a channel with RSI divergence and is rejecting; much of the oversold bounce may already be done and a retest of lows is likely. S5FI/NDFI breadth ratio signals S&P outperforming Nasdaq.
calls.quote: I would be on the sense that you probably come back at some point and retest some of those areas

calls.reason: S&P looks better than the Nasdaq; the breadth indicator flipped and suggests a bottom is forming, but he would not chase the gap up and prefers to wait.
calls.quote: the breath is getting better on the market and we probably are starting to carve out a bottom

calls.reason: Global geopolitical instability (Ukraine/Russia, Middle East/Iran, Europe) is the highest in decades, so anything energy-related, and materials, should do very well; CNQ chart looks perfect but he would not chase it.
calls.quote: Anything energy related to me is going higher because of all the instability that you have in the world right now.
